description: Promotes scripts/model_advisor.py (prose-only advisory helper) into a typed runtime routing surface under scripts/models/. Adds TaskClass, ModelRole, RouteDecision, RouterMode enums; a frozen RouteRecord dataclass; a passive LocalModelInventory; and the ModelRouter itself. The router is a pure function of (task_class, mode, config, inventory) — it never invokes a model, never calls a subprocess, never calls the network, and never reads from T:/. Dry-run is the default mode and never sets execution_authorized=True. Unsupported task classes (including UNKNOWN) fail closed with ROUTE_BLOCKED_UNSUPPORTED_TASK_CLASS. Stale model ids (engineer-v10-dsl, observer-v5-dsl, sentinel-v3, etc.) fail closed with ROUTE_BLOCKED_STALE_MODEL_ID. Missing local model availability falls back along a deterministic chain whose terminus is ModelRole.NO_MODEL. Corpus eligibility and training eligibility are NEVER flipped to True by routing alone.
purpose: Rung 10 of the post-audit Claude-lane sequence. With BLOCKED_UNSAFE=0, MUST_MIGRATE=0, UNKNOWN=0, PROGRAMBENCH=56 preserved, and the architecture gauntlet wired into CI, the apparatus is at the cleanest possible state to start *deciding* when a model is allowed to participate. The router is the gatekeeper that the next rungs (LLM_MOCKED_INTAKE_REPAIR_LOCK_001, SAFE_PATCH_DIFF_ROLLBACK_LOCK_001, VERIFIED_REPAIR_TRACE_LOCK_001) will compose against. Also cleans up the stale v10/v5 default ids in scripts/codebase_explorer.py lines 58-59 surfaced during the gap-to-100 audit.
files_modified: scripts/codebase_explorer.py (lines 58-59: stale v10/v5 defaults replaced with current v11/v6)
invariants: ModelRouter.route() is a pure function of (task_class, mode, config, inventory) — identical inputs produce byte-identical RouteRecord dicts.
DEFAULT_ROUTES covers every TaskClass except UNKNOWN; UNKNOWN is intentionally absent and fails closed with ROUTE_BLOCKED_UNSUPPORTED_TASK_CLASS.
STALE_MODEL_IDS and CURRENT_MODEL_IDS are disjoint frozensets.
STALE_MODEL_IDS contains the two ids that previously appeared as defaults in scripts/codebase_explorer.py lines 58-59 (engineer-v10-dsl, observer-v5-dsl).
Dry-run mode never sets execution_authorized=True for any task class.
corpus_write_authorized and training_eligible are False for ALL RouteRecords produced by the router, in either mode, for any TaskClass.
VERIFIER_SUMMARY (and any task with NO_MODEL terminus) returns ROUTE_NO_MODEL_REQUIRED when inventory is empty — never blocked.
Stale ids short-circuit BEFORE availability check and BEFORE mode dispatch.
scripts/models/*.py contains no `import subprocess`, no `from subprocess`, no `import urllib`, no `from urllib`, no `import socket`, no `import http`.
Router exercise (route every TaskClass in both modes) leaves all locks/sentinel/*.json and assurance/evidence/evidence_index.json hash-unchanged.
scripts/codebase_explorer.py no longer carries `determinex-engineer-v10-dsl` or `determinex-observer-v5-dsl` as positional defaults.
Audit counts: BLOCKED_UNSAFE=0, MUST_MIGRATE=0, UNKNOWN=0, PROGRAMBENCH>=56.
Signed evidence is unmutated by router exercise.
remaining_gaps: Router does NOT perform live availability probing of Ollama or any local engine. A future rung (MODEL_ROUTER_LIVE_LOCAL_MODEL_ADMISSION_LOCK_001) may add an opt-in probe routed through intake.hardened_runner.
Router does NOT yet enforce allow_network_models against actual network-bound model ids — that gate belongs to the caller in LLM_MOCKED_INTAKE_REPAIR_LOCK_001 once the live providers are integrated.
scripts/model_advisor.py remains as a separate advisory helper. A later rung may wrap its recommendations as one signal into the router's role-to-model mapping; this rung does NOT delete it.

Other scripts still carrying stale ids as defaults (determinex_benchmark_5run.py, determinex_codeclash_agent.py role-tag fallbacks, determinex_setup.py wizard defaults, fine_tuning calibration JSON) are out of scope for this rung — they are read-only orchestrators (LEGACY_EXEMPT_READ_ONLY) and a future MODEL_ID_DRIFT_SWEEP_LOCK could consolidate them.

Configuration is via constructor + env vars only. A YAML config layer was suggested in the directive; deferred — env-var + DEFAULT_ROUTES dict is reproducible and testable today, and a YAML wrapper can be added without breaking the lock invariants.
